# IT之家 (ITHome)

> > Leading Chinese technology news and product database covering consumer electronics, smartphones, AI, and the latest developments from Huawei, Tencent, and China's tech industry.

IT之家 (ITHome) is a comprehensive Chinese technology portal operated by 软媒 (Ruanmei), providing in-depth coverage of IT industry news, product specifications, and digital device reviews. The site focuses on Chinese tech companies like Huawei, Tencent, ByteDance, and emerging technologies including AI, smart home systems, and telecommunications.

## Key Topics

- Huawei and Mate X7 series
- Consumer electronics and smartphones
- Chinese tech industry (腾讯, 字节跳动, 中国联通)
- AI technology and OpenClaw
- Smart home and 鸿蒙智家 (HarmonyOS)
- Product specifications and reviews
- Tencent Cloud services
- Telecom industry developments
- Tech industry leaders (余承东)
- Digital product launches
- AWE (Appliance & Electronics World Expo)
- Tech news from Wuhan and Hubei region
- New product releases and announcements

## Product Database & Specifications

- [IT之家产品百科 专业数码产品中心-软媒旗下](https://ku.ithome.com/): Product database for smartphones, laptops & digital devices with specs

## IT Industry News & Coverage

- [IT业界_科技新闻报道_IT之家](https://it.ithome.com/ityejie): IT industry news covering tech companies, trends & product launches
